notes: Three articles in the eye/ear/heart series take a supplied their under rule 76, no genitive pronoun standing in those phrases, while the one phrase that does express αὐτῶν leaves its article unrepresented under rule 20 — one verse writing both, which is what shows the test is availability.

In τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου the inner article is emptied by the demonstrative (rule 38) and the outer ἡ by the prenominal possessive people's (rules 20, 57); rule 57's inner-article clause does not apply because the determiner on the possessor is written by τούτου, not supplied.
ἐπαχύνθη → is waxed gross heads on the meaning-bearing complement rather than the copular waxed (rule 17).
